title: Deeper/broader independent 2D reader and consumer-boundary screen
mode: primary repository/documentation review with read-only local plan reconciliation
scope: Screen newly visible DWG/DXF parser implementations outside the current peer matrix
Determine the exact evidence ceiling of a standalone 2D DWG renderer/parser candidate
Refresh the FreeCAD DXF and DWG consumer boundary using official documentation/source entry points
Refine implementation readiness without adding a peer dependency, routine validation, fixture, or support claim

method.kind: Review GitHub repository README, object-type and version documentation, commit history, official FreeCAD DXF documentation and source entry points, then reconcile with existing local plan gates
method.limitations: ft_model capabilities and corpus descriptions are project-authored; its fixtures and expected-value provenance were not audited and no binary/source build was run. Its reviewed short commit ID is discovery provenance only. FreeCAD documentation is from the official documentation repository, which is archived; mutable FreeCAD source was not pinned to an installed release. No runtime interoperability or semantic result is established.

sources.revision: README/docs on main as accessed 2026-10-18; history lists V1.0.0 milestone short revision 408e34e dated 2026-06-06
sources.observed: Project describes a self-developed C++20 DWG/DXF reader and 2D rendering engine, DWG release families R2000 through R2018, a scene-graph-to-JSON rendering path, synthetic DXF regression baseline, and real-DWG sentinel data. Its type reference labels fixed DWG type 31 SOLID as a planar fill. The reviewed public route does not document a DWG/DXF writer, AcDs join, ACIS semantic reader, or B-rep kernel.
sources.limits: Self-description and source documentation do not qualify parser completeness or semantic correctness. Test-data provenance and expected manifests were not audited; no project binary was built or run. The short revision is not sufficient for a reproducible comparison. A renderer/JSON projection may omit source identity and parser state.

sources.revision: Official documentation main and FreeCAD source main accessed 2026-10-18; documentation repository reports archived 2026-04-01; no exact installed application/source commit was selected
sources.observed: The official Draft DXF page documents separate built-in C++ and optional legacy Python importers with different entity coverage, states that stock FreeCAD cannot read the binary ACIS/SAT blob used for DXF 3D solids, and describes DWG as external converter output to DXF followed by the selected DXF importer.
sources.limits: The documentation repository is archived, and mutable source/docs do not qualify a particular release, platform, importer backend, preference profile, converter, or native behavior. This is a route-scope boundary, not a local libdxfrw result or an ACIS semantic test.

existingOwnersRefined: Peer admission and differential evidence matrix
newWatchlistCandidates: hhcme/ft_model — optional 2D structural/renderer differential only, provenance-gated
assessment.planImpact: Keep ft_model off the routine validation path. Admit only a one-time optional 2D differential if a specific unresolved field/graph gap remains, and only after full source/build identity plus test-data provenance are established. Use independent expected values and entity/owner dispositions; reject raster/render-only output as structural evidence. Distinguish planar DXF SOLID from 3DSOLID/ACIS. Retain FreeCAD's separate converter, intermediate DXF, importer backend/settings, explicit entities, opaque carrier, and semantic-solid evidence rows.
